messages:
lara: quick note from canary: when swapping peering the connector flip caused client IP changes for long-lived uploads. retry noise but not full outage.
sam: saw similar in staging. eviction is eager when CP heartbeat misses.
peter: short proposal: add soft-handoff where old connector stays in read-only NAT mode for existing flows for a small window (eg 3m) while new connector accepts new flows.
lara: agrees. downside is ENI pressure. need quota guard and opt-in per tenant.
sam: also add metric tenant_ip_flip_count and snat_fallback_rates for visibility.
ops-bot: scheduled: soft-handoff-canary at 2026-04-12T02:00Z. owners: @lara @sam.
peter: i'll open a tiny RFC with config knobs: lease_ttl, lease_extend_step, soft_handoff_window, and opt_in flag.
lara: include runbook steps for forced eviction and alert on ENI saturation. thanks.
